1. Osman thinks it's important for children to grow up / growing up with other children.
2. Sophia says that she was sometimes a little lonely to play / playing by herself.
3. Lilli says she always had enough to eat / eating as a child.
4. Sean feels that he had no real problems to be / being an only child.
